title: New York City to ban deceptive subscription practices
summary: New York City has enacted legislation to ban deceptive subscription practices, targeting businesses that use dark patterns and misleading tactics to trap consumers in recurring payments. The new law requires clearer cancellation options and prohibits hidden fee structures in subscription services.
problem_solved: Protects consumers from manipulative subscription services that make it difficult to cancel or hide true costs.
why_valuable: Creates legal framework to hold businesses accountable for deceptive practices and empowers consumers with clearer subscription management rights.
